description: A one-line behaviour fix in the manager's URL module. `parseSerializedParam` (`code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts:42-50`) encodes each `name:value` pair of a serialized `args`/`globals` segment and then drops any pair that fails `key && value`. Because `encodeURIComponent('')` is the empty string, a pair such as `text:` is discarded along with the nameless pairs the guard was written for. `mergeSerializedParams` (url.ts:52-58) calls it for both the inherited and the extra segment, and `getStoryHrefs` (url.ts:281-286) calls `mergeSerializedParams` whenever `inheritArgs`/`inheritGlobals` is set, so the empty value is lost from both `managerHref` and `previewHref` — which is the link the "Open in isolation mode" toolbar button opens with `window.open`. The fix narrows that filter so it tests only the pair's name, keeping a pair whose value is the empty string and still dropping a pair whose name is empty. Everything else in the chain already carries an empty value end to end: `buildArgsParam` serialises `{ text: '' }` to `text:`, `code/core/src/manager-api/lib/url.ts` filters only `null`/`undefined` so the address bar keeps it, and the preview's `parseArgsParam` reads `text:` back as `''`. So the approach deliberately changes nothing outside that one predicate: not the arguments format in the address, not the toolbar button, not the Controls panel, not the preview, and no dependency. An empty merge result still yields an href with no `args` parameter at all, because `getStoryHrefs` only appends `&args=` when the merged segment is non-empty (url.ts:299). The three acceptance tests already committed in `code/e2e-internal/e2e/isolation-mode-args.spec.ts` are the oracle, and the plan is one task because the whole change is that predicate.
out_of_scope: Unit tests for the manager URL module: the spec puts them out of scope because forge's only test command, `bash scripts/forge-e2e-internal.sh`, runs the Playwright suite in `code/e2e-internal` and would never collect `code/core/src/manager-api/tests/url.test.js`.
Globals. `mergeSerializedParams` serves `args` and `globals` alike, so the fix carries an empty-string global too, but no criterion exercises one and no separate work is done for it.

The copied story link and the isolation-mode keyboard shortcut (`code/core/src/manager-api/modules/shortcuts.ts`). Both build their link through the same `getStoryHrefs` call and so follow the fix; neither is separately tested, because reading the clipboard needs browser permissions this suite does not grant.
A pair written with no colon (`args=text`), which the current code keeps as the literal value `undefined`. Unreported, unchanged, untested.
Any change to the arguments format in the address: an empty value stays written as the name, a colon and nothing after it.
Any change to the toolbar button (`share.tsx`), the Controls panel (`Text.tsx`) or the preview.
Any change to the story `core-controls-basics--defined` or its template components, and any change to the auto-opening colour picker the acceptance tests dismiss.
Any change to forge's test script, to `code/e2e-internal/playwright.config.ts`, or to the shared `code/e2e-internal/helpers.ts`.
A changeset, release note or migration entry for the fix.
rollback_plan: The run branch carries, in order, the `acceptance:` commits already present, a `forge:` commit holding this plan, and then task 001's `build:` commits (one per fix round; task 001 has `unit_tests: none`, so it writes no `tests:` commit). To undo the change before the pull request merges: `git revert --no-commit` task 001's `build:` commits newest first, which restores the `key && value` predicate in `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts`, then commit. After the pull request has merged, revert its merge commit instead (`git revert -m 1 <merge sha>`), which removes both the fix and the acceptance spec `code/e2e-internal/e2e/isolation-mode-args.spec.ts`. Either way the revert touches only that one product file (plus, for the merge revert, the acceptance spec), so the previous behaviour — empty-string arguments dropped from the isolation-mode link — returns with no other surface affected.

tasks.definition_of_done: `parseSerializedParam` in `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts` filters on the pair's name alone, so `mergeSerializedParams('text:', '')` returns `text:`, `mergeSerializedParams('number:5;text:', '')` returns a segment carrying both `number:5` and `text:`, and `mergeSerializedParams('', '')` still returns the empty string — which keeps `getStoryHrefs` appending no `args` parameter at all (url.ts:299) when there is nothing to carry. The existing non-empty merge behaviour is unchanged, so `code/core/src/manager-api/tests/url.test.js`'s `supports extra args and globals with merging` still describes the code (`&args=a:2;b:2;c:3`), and `args=text` with no colon still yields the literal `text:undefined` as before. All three acceptance tests in `code/e2e-internal/e2e/isolation-mode-args.spec.ts` — `AC-01 the new tab shows a cleared text argument as empty`, `AC-02 an empty argument in the manager address reaches the new tab address`, `AC-03 the new tab carries every argument pair of the manager address` — pass, and no file outside `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts` is modified.
tasks.intent: In `parseSerializedParam` in `code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts`, narrow the pair filter so it keeps a pair whose encoded value is the empty string and still drops a pair whose name is empty.
produces: parseSerializedParam(param: string) in code/core/src/manager-api/modules/url.ts keeps a name/value pair whose value is the empty string and drops a pair whose name is empty

mergeSerializedParams(params: string, extraParams: string) returns a segment that includes every pair with a non-empty name from both inputs, empty values written as `name:`, and the empty string when neither input has such a pair
tasks.rationale: The spec's "The fix": the merge step that assembles arguments for the isolation-mode link is the only place an empty string is discarded, and line 49's `.filter(([key, value]) => key && value)` is the line the issue names. Serves AC-01, AC-02 and AC-03.
tasks.unit_tests_reason: The spec puts unit tests for this module out of scope: forge's only test command runs the Playwright suite, so none would be collected. The three named tests are red now and fully specify the predicate: AC-03 drives five segments — none, `text:hi`, `text:`, `number:5;text:`, `text:;select:c` — pinning the empty instance, both sides of the name guard, and empty mixed with non-empty.
